scripts.text:
[Skia]
Welcome!
I've been wondering when you would arrive.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
歡迎！我一直盼著您來呢。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You are here!
The people from other families all have taken their seats.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
您來了！
其他家族的人都已經入座了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
By the way.........
After I left the Banquet Hall
....No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
順便一提...
我離開宴會廳之後...
...不，算了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Nothing good can be heard if we keep them waiting for any longer. Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
再讓他們等下去，可就少不了一頓數落了。
走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
^4d4dffThere is a seat left next to Lord Richard. It must be the seat reserved for an observer.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
^4d4dff理查德大人旁邊還有個空位，應該是留給觀禮者的。^000000

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
好了，我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What is going on...
We shall leave this place first.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
這是怎麼回事...先離開這裡再說。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Is everyone all right...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍納]
大家都沒事吧...

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
All seem well.
...I shall get going. The brothers don't look so good.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
看起來大家都沒事。
...我該走了。兄弟們的情況不太好。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Phew, let's get out of here.
Sis, let's get out!
Nyhill, you should come with us!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
呼，我們快離開這裡吧。
姐姐，我們快走吧！
尼希爾，你也跟我們走！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Other people will get out on their own!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
其他人會自己離開的！

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
...There seems to be no one dead.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...好像沒有人喪命。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Peter is in a critical condition.
...Would you mind fighting against the intruder for us?
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
彼得的情況很危急。
...您能幫我們對抗入侵者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
....
.... ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is missing...
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
...
...^4d4dff泰拉·格洛麗亞^000000不見了...

scripts.text: Terra Gloria?
scripts.translation: 泰拉·格洛麗亞？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is the crown passed down in the palace of Rune-Midgarts.
It means more than an ordinary crown.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
那是盧恩·米德加茲王室代代相傳的王冠，意義遠非普通王冠可比。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Has it been taken by them?
What on earth...!
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
是被他們拿走了嗎？
這到底是...！

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What is hidden here is not known to anyone... Except the seven royal families...!
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
這裡藏著什麼，除了七大王族，無人知曉...！

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Does it mean...
...Well, first things first, There are things to find out.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
難道說...
...不，先處理眼前的事，有些情況還得查清楚。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Let's get out of here now.
There is much left for use to find out.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們現在就離開這裡。
還有很多事情要弄清楚。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Whoever left here, clear out with the wounded near you!
The Room of Consciousness will be closed for a while!
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
還在這裡的人，帶上身邊的傷員撤離！
意識之室要暫時關閉了！

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Peter has been wounded.
We need to move him fast.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
彼得受傷了。
我們需要儘快轉移他。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I'll see you out there.
You can leave through the door you have entered.
Let's meet at the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
scripts.translation:
[克羅內克]
我們外面見。
您從來時的門出去，到王族往事之地會合。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...This... Is all... My fault...

[{0}]
We should watch the Ritual of Blessing.
Don't get out now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
得留下觀看賜福儀式，現在還不能出去。
